title: Verdier-duality exchange
statement:
In the six-functor datum of
[def-fix-six-functor-datum], assume that $f$ and the structure
morphisms $a_X$, $a_Y$ are
exceptionally
admissible, and put

$$
\omega_{Y,\Lambda}=Ra_Y^!\Lambda,\qquad
\omega_{X,\Lambda}=Ra_X^!\Lambda,\qquad
D_Y(-)=R\mathcal Hom_{\Lambda}(-,\omega_{Y,\Lambda}),\qquad
D_X(-)=R\mathcal Hom_{\Lambda}(-,\omega_{X,\Lambda}).
$$

For every $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ there is a canonical
isomorphism

$$
D_Y(Rf_!M)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rf_*D_X(M),
$$

natural in $M$, compatible with finite reduction, scalar extension,
and shifts.

proof.text: Apply [sk-thm-sf-verdier-exchange] to the same separated finite-type morphism f and the same three normalized operation systems and compactifications. Its all-stage Package supplies exactly the unit, stage data, ring and projection realizations, exchange naturality, and normalized integral compositor required here. Retain these fields verbatim. Define conclusion(s,hs) and ringShifts(s,hs) by the supplied unconditional conclusions; restrict ringScalar, rationalization, rationalScalar and common to their two admissible endpoints by ignoring their admissibility proofs. Their ScalarShifts use these very same conclusions, so every normalized coefficient and signed-shift field has the required type without a transport or a new choice. This gives the required nonempty admissible Package. The invoked theorem follows the same composition-mate and tensor-Hom route and its DAG dependencies do not reach this node.
